answer.sql:
WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT
    il.invoiceid,
    SUM(il.extendedprice - il.taxamount) AS net_revenue
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
  GROUP BY il.invoiceid
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate) AS invoice_year,
    SUM(lt.net_revenue) AS revenue
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
  JOIN line_totals lt ON lt.invoiceid = i.invoiceid
  WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2014-01-01'
    AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (
      (SELECT revenue FROM yearly WHERE invoice_year = 2015)
      - (SELECT revenue FROM yearly WHERE invoice_year = 2014)
    ) * 100.0
    / NULLIF((SELECT revenue FROM yearly WHERE invoice_year = 2014), 0),
    1
  ) AS revenue_growth_pct
LIMIT 501
